page_title: SAL 2-2 CAG | Salernitana v Cagliari 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' That's the end of the match.
90+11' Daniele Chiffi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) and blew his whistle. Salernitana earn a free kick.
90+11' The referee shows the yellow card to Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana).
90+6' Daniele Chiffi shows a yellow card to Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+5' 2 - 2 Goal! Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Simone Scuffet into the top left corner.
90+4' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) is going to take the penalty!
90+4' Referee Daniele Chiffi is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Salernitana!
90+4' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Salernitana! Let's see what he decides.
90+3' Surely that's handball by one of the Cagliari players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' The booking goes to Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
88' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Benito Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 1:2.
87' Referee Daniele Chiffi points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) goes wild in celebration.
87' Wait! Referee Daniele Chiffi has indicated he is going to review the Salernitana goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
86' 1 - 1 Goal! Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
84' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a change. Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) replaces Zito Luvumbo.
83' Substitution. Federico Fazio will be replaced by Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana).
81' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Salernitana comes to nothing.
80' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) sees a yellow card from Daniele Chiffi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
79' Daniele Chiffi shows a yellow card to Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) for a tough tackle.

79' 0 - 1 Goal! Jakub Jankto produces a great pass that finds Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot past the goalkeeper and into the back of the net. 0:1.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) comes onto the pitch for Antonio Candreva.
76' Here is a change. Lassana Coulibaly is going off and Filippo Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana).
75' Salernitana earn a corner.
74' It will be a substitution. Adam Obert (Cagliari) is ready to enter the pitch as Alberto Dossena walks off.
71' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniele Chiffi ignores the protests.
68' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
64' The game has come to an end for Gaetano Oristanio. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jakub Jankto (Cagliari).
64' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
59' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Benoit Costil, who smothers the ball.
58' Great individual play by Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) ends with a shot from distance that flies well wide of the right post.
56' Substitution. Jovane did his best and is replaced by Trivante Stewart (Salernitana).
55' Filippo Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) replacing Grigoris Kastanos.
52' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
49' The free kick from long range, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Salernitana take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' The manager makes a subsitution with Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) coming on for Nahitan Nandez.
46' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Marco Mancosu and he is replaced by Benito Nicolas Viola (Cagliari).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
40' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Tommaso Augello (Cagliari), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
38' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

37' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Benoit Costil, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Corner kick. Cagliari will have an opportunity.
35' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Benoit Costil intercepts the ball.
34' Salernitana quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
33' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
28' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) has a goal ruled out for offside!
25' Jovane (Salernitana) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
23' Marco Mancosu (Cagliari) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
17' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Benoit Costil easily catches the ball.
15' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle. Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) commits a foul after dangerous play.
14' Salernitana can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
13' Salernitana work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
13' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
8' The ball rebounds to Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the left post.
4' Salernitana quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
3' Salernitana have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
